integrity: All finite counts and stabilizers are recomputed from the defining external-difference condition by the bundled verifier. The foundational 1971 DSS publication was verified only to year granularity; no publication day is invented. Because the structured field requires YYYY-MM-DD, first_public_date is the earliest directly relevant inspected public source with a verified exact date, 2004-01-26. The topic is assigned 94A55 in the coding/synchronization sense, supported by the published MSC string 94A55-94B05 for Zhou–Tang.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for affine relabelings of the cyclic coordinate set together with block interchange; it does not assert completeness under any larger non-affine equivalence. Published literature was inspected for the sharp bound, general DSS algorithms, synchronization-code constructions, and the modulus-19 triple-block setting. A historical extended online table and obscure unindexed enumerations remain residual originality risks.
title: Five affine classes of optimal binary difference systems on \(\mathbb Z_{19}\)
